# Let users back up and restore their whole workspace

## What & Why
The current export safely backs up the reusable profile, while answers and application queue entries remain browser-local only. A single workspace backup would make the daily tool easier to recover or move to another browser.

## Done looks like
- A versioned JSON backup includes the profile, answer library, and application queue without dropping fields.
- Import validates every collection before changing any saved data.
- Invalid backups show clear feedback and leave the existing workspace untouched.
